entities.summary: Pickwick Records was an American record label and British record distributor known for its budget album releases of sound-alike recordings, bargain bin reissues, and repackagings under the brands Design, Bravo, Hurrah, and Grand Prix, and children's records on the Cricket and Happy Time labels.
